en.headline: 3 own commits plus 17 automated; 2 ideas opened in openchamber
en.summary: On 2026-10-13, `sogeisetsu` recorded **3 own commits** in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, plus 17 additional automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. The own commits hardened the daily narrative pipeline: one locked `generateNarrative` so it no longer self-blocks on empty input, one removed a duplicated empty-gate in the AI layer and added regression coverage, and one fixed a bug where blank days swallowed the discussion and other appended sections. No pull requests, reviews, issues, or releases were recorded that day. In discussions, the user opened two Ideas in `openchamber/openchamber`: #4823 `[Idea] Expose session context and usage stats to extensions via the SDK` and #4821 `[Idea] Add session aggregate stats to the Context Usage Panel`, both with 0 comments so far.

zh.headline: 3 次本人提交加 17 次自动提交；在 openchamber 新开 2 个 Ideas
zh.summary: 2026-10-13，`sogeisetsu` 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 完成 **3 次本人提交**，另有 17 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。本人提交围绕 daily 叙述流水线加固：一次锁住 `generateNarrative`，使其不再对 empty 输入自行拦截；一次移除 AI 层重复的 empty 闸门并补齐回归用例；一次修复空白天吞掉 discussion 等附加段的问题。当日无 PR、review、issue 或 release。讨论方面，用户在 `openchamber/openchamber` 新开了两个 Ideas：#4823 `[Idea] Expose session context and usage stats to extensions via the SDK` 与 #4821 `[Idea] Add session aggregate stats to the Context Usage Panel`，目前均 0 条评论。
